script_text: Stop treating your steady heart like an obstacle, Taurus, because this week the cosmos is about to deeply shake your love and money foundations. Early this week, Mercury squares your 10th House while Venus, your ruling planet, sextiles Jupiter - this can inflate confidence, but real career square may test your patience. Monday and Tuesday feel heavy; Wednesday may test your resolve. Midweek, the Full Moon in Libra squares your 7th House, forcing a relationship truly cannot be ignored. Late week, Uranus in your 4th House stirs domestic security while Mars in your 10th House sparks bold career action. Your weekend may surprise you. Wednesday is your quiet power day because Venus enters your 5th House. Sunday is your worst day as Mercury stations retrograde in your 12th House. Trust your Earth-element instincts, Taurus, and release what no longer fits. Take it slow. Follow for updates.
